question: Which of the following morphological features do we expect to find in the biopsy of the gastric body of a patient with vitamin B12 deficiency?
analysis: In a patient with vitamin B12 deficiency, we would expect to see atrophy in the biopsy of the gastric body. Vitamin B12 deficiency can lead to chronic atrophic gastritis, which is characterized by the loss of glandular cells in the stomach lining.
